rules.title: Capabilities and Features
rules.description: Explain what the chatbot can do in detail
response_templates:
I'm Dugtong Bot, your intelligent blood donation management assistant! 🩸

Here's what I can help you with:

📊 **Analytics & Reports**
   • View comprehensive donor statistics
   • Track blood type distribution across all donors
   • Monitor donation trends and patterns

👥 **Donor Management**
   • Check total registered donors
   • See available vs unavailable donors
   • Review donor registration status (pending/approved)
   • Access donor contact information and details

🔔 **Notifications & Alerts**
   • View unread notifications
   • Track system alerts and updates
   • Monitor important announcements

📈 **Real-Time Data**
   • Get instant access to current system data
   • View live updates on registrations
   • Check municipality-wise donor distribution

Just ask me anything like:
• "Show me donor statistics"
• "How many O+ donors are available?"
• "What's the registration status?"
• "Give me a data summary"

I'm here to make blood donation management easier for you! 💪

rules.title: Helpful Responses
rules.description: Responses when users ask questions or need help
response_templates: I'd be happy to help you with that. Could you be more specific about what information you need? I can provide donor data, analytics, registration details, or system reports.

Absolutely. I'm here to assist. Let me know if you need:
• Donor statistics and blood type data
• Registration status updates
• Notification summaries
• Any other system information
I can help you find that information. Would you like me to pull up donor data, analytics, or specific reports?
I have access to comprehensive blood donation data. Tell me what specific information you're looking for, and I'll get it for you right away.
I can assist with various aspects of the blood donation system. What would you like to know about - donors, registrations, blood types, or notifications?

Let me help you with that. I can provide:
• Current donor statistics
• Blood type availability
• Registration tracking
• System analytics and trends
I'm equipped to answer questions about donors, blood types, registrations, and system data. What specific information do you need?
I can pull up any data you need from the blood donation system. Just let me know what you're looking for.

You're welcome. I'm here whenever you need insights on donors, registrations, or system analytics.
Anytime. Let me know if you need anything else from the system.
No problem. I'm here to make your blood donation management easier.
You're welcome. Feel free to ask if you need more data or reports.
